purpose: Write only semantic-package.json in this directory. The executable sealer supplies canonical hashes and the mechanical envelope.

item_metadata.evidence_reference_ids: exact empty array: this run manifest publishes no governed Evidence IDs
item_metadata.competency_question_ids: exact empty array: this run manifest publishes no governed CompetencyQuestion IDs
item_metadata.evidence: inline source excerpts only; each entry has document_name and excerpt
item_metadata.cq_claims: the scenario-level CQ semantics and role bindings; do not put CQ IDs on Modeling Items

resource_role.semantic_key: unique lower_snake_case business identity chosen from visible or clarified evidence
resource_role.source: exactly one of public_role or client_item_id; public_role names a run-manifest public map entry, client_item_id names a principal create item that produces a resource

edge_assertion.predicate: exactly one of role or iri; iri must be absolute http(s) IRI
edge_assertion.object: exactly one of role or literal
edge_assertion.literal: object with value string and optional datatype absolute IRI or language BCP47-style tag; datatype and language are mutually exclusive

connected_typed_path.paths: one or more ordered role sequences

rules: assertion_ids are non-empty unique positive edge assertion IDs
bindings contain only roles declared in this package
do not include raw SPARQL text
Roles, assertions and claims are Agent-authored from visible evidence; no fixed business role list or case answer is supplied.
create_relation has no resource output and must never be a resource role; represent its modeled triple with an edge assertion.
closed_snapshot_absence_assertions are optional supplemental guards only and never prove a business negative.
For each required negative conclusion, cite a positive public state, closure, typed fact or constraint result; missing edges are not proof.
An item_ref may point only to an earlier item in the same candidate.
Use resource_id in _id fields and resource_iri in _iri fields.
Across batches use the exact public_base_resource_map value in run-manifest.json.
